tasks.CompareCoefficients: Comparing coefficients from both sides to determine the values of $p$, $q$, and $r$.
tasks.ExpandProduct: Expanding the product of the factorized polynomial and a general cubic polynomial to match the form of $x^9 + px^6 + qx^3 + r$.
tasks.FactorizePolynomial: Factorizing the given polynomial $x^3 - 3x^2 + 4x - 1$ to find its roots.
